object_description: fragmented ensemble of two U-shaped elements and an isolated building around a large interior park
design_condition: three elements form an enclosure that creates a new centrality with a green heart, public programmes placed on the ground floor to the west and entrances organised on the periphery

positive: A deliberate and innovative urban proposal measured on a territorial scale by a dialogue between city and nature
The three elements provide links with the various components of the site, creating a new centrality
Public programmes on the ground floor to the west create an urban vision of the road
They complement the urban square at the entrance to the site
The large park allows for contemplation and calm as well as exchanges and life in the district
Each element benefits from views to the heart of the complex or to the wider landscape
The proposed morphology creates different orientations
The jury notes the interest of the initial conceptual choices, particularly the complex organised around a park
The central location generously landscaped with a lake and green spaces is very appealing
The public spaces are rounded off by an urban-style square where the buildings meet
The flexible, free-form character contrasts with the rigour of the teaching buildings, creating a real break
Foundations, structure, energy and sustainable development have been well understood and addressed
The compactness of the buildings and the recommended construction methods lead to an economical project
A good evolution is noted between the first and second stage
negative: The park fails to convince of its true purpose
The treatment of the ground floor components and entrances does not exploit the relationship with the park
Most entrances are located on the periphery, so the park remains a place of passage
The space does not encourage vitality in relation to the programme
The scale of the two U-shaped elements denies connections with the neighbouring districts and closes off the site
The expression and the proposed images associate the ensemble with an administrative complex
The role and nature of the park has progressed little between stages
The project fails to seduce for this large area of student housing
The vehicle crossover encroaches into the legal distance from the forest, incompatible with the allocation plan
